name: Site Planner
description: Fixed-root MCP adapter for inspecting, generating, optimizing, previewing, forking, and applying changes to a pinned local Site Planner workspace.

secrets.name: SITE_PLANNER_WRITE_HMAC_V1
secrets.label: Site Planner write-authorization HMAC key
secrets.description: Exactly 32 random bytes encoded as 43 unpadded base64url characters. Service Desk uses this key to authorize one request-bound fork or apply operation after approval.

meta.author: RUDI
meta.boundary: The adapter executes only the configured Site Planner JSON CLI against a fixed workspace and exact clean Git revision. It does not perform zoning, entitlement, parking, finance, or underwriting analysis.
meta.secretGuidance: Keep SITE_PLANNER_WRITE_HMAC_V1 in RUDI secret state. Do not expose it to agents, logs, artifacts, configuration JSON, or tool output.
